svg.aria-label: clowk architecture: catch credentials at the paste boundary, store them out of the way, and record what depends on them
svg.title: clowk — architecture
svg.text: clowk
catches credentials at the paste boundary, keeps them out of the way, and records what depends on them
v1 · no daemon, no proxy, no encryption
a capture-and-bookkeeping tool —
deliberately not a security boundary
real value
reference only
clowk component
blocked
THE ONE THING THAT PREVENTS A LEAK · BUILT AND VERIFIED LIVE
YOU PASTE
sk_live_4eC39Hq…
into the chat
nothing has been sent
to the provider yet
HOOK · LOCAL
UserPromptSubmit
220 gitleaks rules,
keyword + entropy gated,
before anything is sent
ON A HIT
the turn is BLOCKED — the model
receives nothing, and the transcript
on disk records nothing
no other part of this design prevents a leak;
everything else is hygiene and bookkeeping
YOU GET BACK
$STRIPE_KEY
your prompt, rewritten and already on
your clipboard. Repaste is one keystroke.
the only friction here, and unavoidable: a hook can
block a prompt but cannot rewrite one in place
THE STORE
~/.clowk/vault.json
mode 0600 · one file · plaintext
Out of settings.local.json — so it is not in every session's
env, and not in a directory anyone might commit.
Plaintext on purpose: encryption cannot help when the agent
runs as you and the key must be reachable by the same user.
THE LEDGER AND THE CLI
clowk add · set · list · clear · rename · uses
add lets a human type a key at the terminal instead of
pasting it into a chat. list never prints a value.
The ledger records when it was caught, where from, and
every command that used it — so rotation is not guesswork.
DEFENCE IN DEPTH · PreToolUse DENY — CHEAP, REAL, AND NOT A BOUNDARY
~/.clowk/ · .env · *.pem · id_rsa · git credential fill · security find-generic-password
that last one printed a live GitHub token during this design session — one line, no attack, no clowk involved. It is the easiest accidental credential read on a developer machine.
LATER · HYGIENE, NEVER ENFORCEMENT — each gets a value out of your env, none is a control
T1 · NATIVE CREDENTIAL HOOKS
git · aws · docker · kubectl
Lateral, not a step up: clowk's own store
is exactly as readable as ~/.aws/credentials
T2 · LOCALHOST PROXY
base-URL redirect, no CA to trust
Bearer APIs only — not AWS, which signs the
request. Needs a curated route + auth table.
T3 · SCOPED INJECTION
clowk run -- ./deploy.sh
Real value in one child's env for one
command. Output scrubbed, use logged.
WHAT THIS STOPS
a pasted key reaching the model, the provider, or the transcript
the key living in every session's env, in a committable directory
not knowing what depends on a key when you have to rotate it
the easy accidents: .env, a private key, git credential fill
WHAT IT DOES NOT
a same-user read. Whatever clowk can read, cat can read.
a file you @-mention, or Grep showing contents to the model
a credential in a format the 220 rules do not recognise
a real boundary needs a separate OS user, a container, or a signed binary
